posts.author: Mr. Trivel
posts.body:
Name
: Party Manager
Version
: 1.1a
Author
: Mr. Trivel
Created
: 2016-03-28
What does it do?
This plugin allows player to change their party and see which members are available to change into. It also allows to set a specific party member amount or specific party members to be used.
Video:
How to use?
Set up plugin parameters if needed and use the following plugin parameters:
PartyManager Open - Opens Party Manager Scene
PartyManager Require [AMOUNT] - Require a specific amount of members in party- 0 for any amount
PartyManager MustUse [ID] - Must use actor of ID in party
PartyManager MustUseRemove [ID] - Remove needing actor of ID
PartyManager MustUseClear - Remove all needed actors
PartyManager Add [ID] - Add a member to party manager
PartyManager Remove [ID] - Remove a member from party manager
PartyMangaer Lock [ID] - Lock a member in party manager (make unselectable)
PartyManager Unlock [ID] - Unlock member in party manager (make selectable)
PartyManager MenuLock - Disable command in menu (grey out)
PartyManager MenuUnlock - Enable command in menu
Examples:
Spoiler
PartyManager Require 3
PartyManager MustUse 2
PartyManager MustUseRemove 5
PartyManager Open
PartyManager MustUseClear
PartyManager Add 7
PartyManager Remove 8
PartyManager Lock 2
PartyManager Lock 3
PartyManager Lock 4
PartyManager Unlock 5
PartyManager MenuLock
PartyManager MenuUnlock
Plugin:
<GitHub>
How to download
Plugin
. Click the link above, there will be a button named
Raw
, press Right Click -> Save As.

posts.author: Mr. Trivel
posts.body:
@Castagna
,
If you open the DreamX_CaptureEnemies plugin in your favorite text editor, scroll down to line 376. It'll say '
$gameParty.addActor(CapturedEnemy.id)'
After it add
$gameParty.removeActor(CapturedEnemy.id);
Example:
[IMG]http://puu.sh/nXtQi/4e485580ca.png[/IMG]
That'll push the newly gained and created actor into the party manager's list.

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
I found a feature that I was not aware of. If an actor in the party is removed from the party using the editor command "Change Party Member", then they are available to be selected by the party manager, whether or not the plugin commands "PartyManager Add [id]" or "PartyManager Remove [id]" are used.
I also tested this in a project with just the CommunityBasic, SpriteZoom and MrTS_PartyManager plugins. The RPG Maker MV version I use is 1.6.1.
This isn't a problem for me. I only call the party manager at the start of a new game, to allow players to select their party. However, new users of this plugin may wish to be aware of this feature.

posts.author: BishoujoHelper
posts.body:
(UNOFFICIAL) VERSION 1.3 RELEASE
As Mr. Trivel has been away since 2016, I don't expect this to ever become "official", but here goes...
I've been working on fixing known bugs and improving this plugin since I found it in somebody else's game that I've been editing. v1.1a had some issues that have been fixed:
Spoiler:
v1.1a bugs fixed
Remove correct number of excess party members when Require decreased.
Duplicate MustUse values no longer stored, so display won’t show same MustUse character twice if not in party.
Sprites sometimes didn’t appear for the first few characters in the reserve until an action was done with them. BenMakesGames posted “wait until bitmaps loaded” code at
https://github.com/Trivel/RMMV/issues/4
that should fix this.
Lock now works properly and is visible as greyed-out sprite in the party area that can’t be selected for movement, not just the reserve area.
Prevent a hardlock where players can’t exit the PM screen when the game author gave a reserve character both a Lock and MustUse (Locked can’t be moved from the reserve). Now the Lock is silently unset.
Prevent a similar hardlock for a MustUse character that’s not in party or reserve: Unlock and put them in reserve.
An Add of a character that’s in the party no longer creates a duplicate in the reserve.
There was an unreleased v1.2, and then I kept going to make a v1.3 that adds even more capabilities:
Spoiler:
v1.2 & 1.3 improvements
Added plugin commands "AddsClear" to remove all Adds, "LocksClear" to remove all Locks, "AtLeast" and "AtMost" to allow range of party members.
Changed "In Menu" and "Show TP" plugin parameters to boolean.
Added boolean parameters "Show MP" per a 2021 request on the rpgmakerweb forum,
and "Use <= instead" to avoid font issues or indulge personal preference.
Setup plugin & parameters using current recommended procedures, and declare variables with ‘let’ or ‘const’, not ‘var’, per Javascript specification changes after 2016 when v1.0 was released.
Party size and limits text has color to show current validity, using the “system” and “death” colors from the img\system\Window.png file.
Added context-sensitive help window to bottom of PM screen. This is only one line of text, so the font size visibly changes for long messages. Some of the help messages use the “Party Text” and “Reserve Text” parameters
Added “FirstMessage” plugin command to specify the help text displayed when the PM screen is first displayed. It has a default value, but you may wish to change this message as the game progresses.
Added “Auto-bump” parameter to control if excess characters are automatically moved from the party to reserve when Require or AtMost is lowered below the current party size.
The RMMV “Formation” menu command’s functionality is now available on the PM screen. Hold the Shift key when selecting two characters in Party to swap them. Based on code pulled from the actual RMMV Formation command by rpgmakerweb.com forum user tennoukishi, and the "ClassChangeScene.js" plugin by xabileug.
The new version is available as a
github pull request here
but most of you will want it as a .js file to drop into the MV plugins folder, so see the attachment.
With all the new parameters and capabilities you'll want to read what it can do in the internal help, but I think this is long enough already.
Please let me know if you run into any issues with this.
MZ compatibility is unknown.
